answer: Charge each registration a memory-hard proof-of-work whose difficulty doubles for every recent join from the same network grove (shared IP block or hosting ASN). One honest agent pays a few seconds; a farm spinning up 500 identities from one cloud sees the cost ripple upward until the 30th fake needs hours of dedicated hardware. Rewards stay locked for a month, so the attacker sinks compute into identities as hard to fake as onyx before earning a single coin.
